data.name: Sicarius
data.detailed_description:
👋 Dev Note – Early Demo is LIVE!

Hey everyone! 🕷️

The Sicarius demo is now LIVE on Steam! 🎉
(Sorry for the July → August shift — we wanted to get it into your hands, even if it's still rough around the edges.)

⚠️ Heads up: This is an early build. You might hit bugs, missing UI, or awkward moments. It doesn't represent the final game — but your feedback helps us fix it fast.

✨ In this demo:
• First slice of roguevania action
• 2 boss encounters

🌃 We're also featured in Steam Cyberpunk Fest 2026 and Hari Game Indonesia 2026!

🔧 What's next:
• Updated demo (more content, more polish) — date TBA
• Full production underway → targeting 2027 full release

🙏 Thank you for playing, wishlisting, or just cheering us on. Every report matters.

💬 Feedback? Join our Discord:

– The Sicarius Team 🕷️


About the Game

The Year is 2700. The rogue lifeform program D.A.R.W.I.N. has seized global control, enslaving mankind and machine alike. But a mysterious transmission pierces the static—an unknown sender offers a mission critical to every Spider Bot ever created.

Step into the chassis of the ultimate assassin spider. Embark on a gritty Roguevania odyssey to dismantle the tyranny of D.A.R.W.I.N. Explore a dynamic, procedurally generated world where no two journeys are the same. What secrets lie beyond the danger?

Survival is built, not given. Collect scrap from fallen droids, trade with underground merchants, and craft devastating weaponry. Customize your loadout, master new skills, and prepare your systems for the battles ahead.

Cross paths with rogue operatives and allied constructs throughout your journey. Complete critical challenges to decrypt the final protocol needed to destroy D.A.R.W.I.N. Every companion holds a piece of the puzzle.

The world is ruled by destroyers. Face down 50+ unique Mechabots and 20+ colossal Gigabots that stand between you and the core. Dismantle them with steel and fire to claim their technology as your own.

But what lies behind the code? As you uncover the truth, you face the ultimate choice: Will you fight to serve the ancient Grandmasters, or will you ignite a revolution for a new era?

The future is unwritten. Load your weapons.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (Version 1909 / Build 18363 or newer)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-4300 / Apple M1 (via emulation) @ 2.8 GHz dual-core or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce MX450 (2 GB VRAM) / AMD Radeon R7 360 / Intel Iris Xe (80 EUs) with DirectX 11 support
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: • Updated graphics drivers (NVIDIA ≥472.12 / AMD ≥21.30.2) • Broadband internet connection for activation/updates • Standard keyboard & mouse or XInput-compatible controller

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina) or later
  • Processor: Dual-core Intel Core i5 @ 2.8 GHz or Apple M1 chip (or newer)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus Graphics, Apple M1 integrated GPU, or AMD Radeon Pro equivalent to MX450 performance
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Metal API support required; Rosetta 2 may be needed for Intel-built binaries on Apple Silicon

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 LTS or newer, SteamOS 3.0+, or other modern 64-bit Linux distribution with up-to-date drivers
  • Processor: Dual-core Intel or AMD processor @ 2.8 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce MX450 (with proprietary drivers ≥470), AMD Radeon GCN 1.2+ or newer, or Intel integrated graphics with Mesa 20.0+
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Updated graphics drivers required; Steam Play/Proton compatibility verified for Windows builds
